ambiguities.question: Which performance gate controls advancement?
ambiguities.resolution: Raw-time gamma>1/6 and full-cost gamma>5/18 are separate; advancement requires the latter.
ambiguities.basis: Independent Validator finding F1 and KN-TECH-035.

ambiguities.question: What constitutes root success?
ambiguities.resolution: At least one distinct verified full-point match; multiplicity-weighted counts are secondary and cannot substitute for the Boolean event.

ambiguities.question: How is external novelty treated when KB retrieval is unavailable?

ambiguities.basis: AGENTS.md retrieval bounds and the current empty/unavailable KB status.
